source.test: createNewServer(name:...) -- Paper archive-first shortcut, archive hit

notes: Archive-first only runs `if flavor == .paper && configManager.config.saveDownloadedJars` (line 258): a lightweight `PaperDownloader.fetchLatestMetadata()` call (no jar bytes) builds `paper-<version>-build<build>.jar` and checks it against the archive directory *before* any real download; a hit copies the archived jar, writes the version sidecar, and sets `usedArchive = true`, so the download branch below is skipped entirely.
